A '''Khormai''' accompanied [[Unidentified Khormai 2|another member]] of the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] within [[Attuma Duum's headquarters]] on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] near [[Cavamina Minor]] c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The two Khormai were present at the destruction of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] flotillas that had been lured into the mined asteroid field by Duum. When a Human named Shon-Ju infiltrated Duum's base and disabled its shields, however, the station itself came under threat of the mined asteroids and was destroyed.
